items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为支持将带有 @DirtiesContext 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 ApplicationContext 标记为 dirty（脏）提供支持。

items.source: Utility methods for working with @TestPropertySource and adding test PropertySources to the Environment.
items.translation: 用于处理@TestPropertySource以及向Environment添加测试PropertySources的实用方法。

items.source: Abstract, generic extension of AbstractContextLoader that loads a GenericApplicationContext.
items.translation: 抽象且通用的 AbstractContextLoader 扩展，用于加载一个GenericApplicationContext。

items.source: BeanFactoryInitializer that eagerly initializes DynamicPropertyRegistrar beans.
items.translation: BeanFactoryInitializer 会急切初始化 DynamicPropertyRegistrar beans。

items.source: Concrete implementation of AbstractGenericContextLoader that reads bean definitions from Groovy scripts and XML configuration files.
items.translation: `GroovyGenericContextLoader` 是 `AbstractGenericContextLoader` 的具体实现，它从 Groovy 脚本和 XML 配置文件读取 bean 定义。

items.source: Concrete implementation of AbstractGenericContextLoader that loads bean definitions from component classes.
items.translation: `AbstractGenericContextLoader` 的 `具体实现`，用于从组件类加载 bean 定义。

items.source: Concrete implementation of AbstractGenericContextLoader that reads bean definitions from XML resources.
items.translation: `AbstractGenericContextLoader` 的具体实现，该实现从 XML 资源中读取 bean 定义。

items.source: Utility methods for working with @TestConstructor.
items.translation: 用于处理@TestConstructor的实用方法。

items.source: DelegatingSmartContextLoader is a concrete implementation of AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader that delegates to a GenericXmlContextLoader (or a GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader if Groovy is present in the classpath) and an AnnotationConfigContextLoader.
items.translation: DelegatingSmartContextLoader 是 AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader 的一个具体实现，它委托给一个 GenericXmlContextLoader（如果类路径中存在 Groovy，则委托给 GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader）和一个 AnnotationConfigContextLoader。

items.source: Default implementation of the ActiveProfilesResolver strategy that resolves active bean definition profiles based solely on profiles configured declaratively via ActiveProfiles.profiles() or ActiveProfiles.value().
items.translation: `ActiveProfilesResolver` 接口的默认实现策略，该策略仅根据通过 ActiveProfiles.profiles() 或 ActiveProfiles.value() 以声明方式配置的配置文件，解析活动 Bean 定义配置文件。

items.source: Abstract base class for TestExecutionListener implementations that provide support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: 用于提供支持的 `` 实现的抽象基类，可将带有 `@DirtiesContext` 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 `` 标记为 dirty。

items.source: AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader serves as an abstract base class for implementations of the SmartContextLoader SPI that delegate to a set of candidate SmartContextLoaders (i.e., one that supports XML configuration files or Groovy scripts and one that supports annotated classes) to determine which context loader is appropriate for a given test class's configuration.
items.translation: AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader 作为 SmartContextLoader SPI 实现的抽象基类，该实现委托给一组 候选 SmartContextLoaders（即一个支持 XML 配置文件或 Groovy 脚本的加载器，以及一个支持注解类的加载器），以确定哪个上下文加载器适用于给定测试类的配置。

items.source: Utility methods for SmartContextLoaders that deal with component classes (for example, @Configuration classes).
items.translation: 用于处理组件类（例如，@Configuration 类）的 SmartContextLoaders 实用方法。

items.source: Abstract ordered implementation of the TestExecutionListener API.
items.translation: 抽象的 ordered 实现，针对 TestExecutionListener API。

items.source: Abstract application context loader that provides a basis for all concrete implementations of the ContextLoader SPI.
items.translation: 抽象应用程序上下文加载器，为所有具体的 `ContextLoader SPI 实现提供基础。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the TestContextBootstrapper interface which provides most of the behavior required by a bootstrapper.
items.translation: `TestContextBootstrapper` 接口的抽象实现，该接口提供了引导程序所需的大部分行为。

items.source: Default implementation of the BootstrapContext interface.
items.translation: BootstrapContext接口的默认实现。

items.source: Default implementation of the TestContext interface.
items.translation: TestContext接口的默认实现。

items.source: Default implementation of the TestContextBootstrapper SPI.
items.translation: 默认实现 `TestContextBootstrapper` SPI。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持Spring TestContext Framework的类。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which makes sure that common caches are cleared once they are no longer required.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 确保在不再需要时清除常用缓存。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for dependency injection and initialization of test instances.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 提供对测试实例的依赖注入和初始化支持。

items.source:
Strategy for providing named properties — for example, for looking up
key-value pairs in a generic fashion.
items.translation: 提供命名属性的策略——例如，以通用方式查找键值对。
